observations: Photos 0, 1, 2: one used automatic gearbox lying on dirt ground in a parts yard, with a transfer case bolted to the rear, so a 4WD unit.
Photos 0, 1, 2: aluminium bell housing with a yellow paint dot, cooler lines and a dipstick tube still attached, wiring harness and connectors present.
Photos 0, 1, 2: the transfer case has a front output and a rubber-booted shaft; heavy dirt and oil grime all over the case.
Photos 0, 1, 2: a watermark 'GEARUP INC.' over the image; other gearboxes and engines lie around it under a tarpaulin.
No photo shows an identification tag, casting number or label; no brand or model is readable on the unit.
Nothing in the photos shows the vehicle it came from, and the unit is not shown running.
